steps.label: Find sterile gauze
steps.text: Get sterile gauze from the bottom compartment. Look for its light, and tell me when you have it. If blood is spurting or flowing continuously, press on the wound with a clean cloth right now instead of waiting for gauze, and call 911.

steps.label: Apply direct pressure
steps.text: Put the gauze directly on the arm wound and hold firm, steady pressure. Tell me when pressure is on. If bleeding is heavy or does not stop, call 911 now.

steps.label: Keep pressure and seek care
steps.text: Keep steady pressure until bleeding stops. If it is heavy or does not stop, call 911 now. A deep or gaping wound needs medical evaluation; do not rely on this box alone.
